audit.why: Poppy 54.32% over 1377 games — the largest sample in this slice. EVEN 6/10 is slightly conservative but the phase shape (Poppy early and first item, Sylas late) is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 said Poppy while whys[6] ('Full-AP Sylas drain-heals through your flat damage') and spikes[3] ('Sylas out-scales') both say the opposite. Row 4 said Skill while whys[4] says you trade through his stolen ult.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Sylas and agrees with the written reasoning.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Poppy, row 6 to Sylas, both layers as one group, with the 2+ items rating and why brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Abscond as the only dash Steadfast Presence answers. Kingslayer (W) is also a lunge — a dash — on a 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s cooldown, so W stops his heal-lunge as well as his engage. Neither ability was named anywhere on the page and no cooldown appeared.
audit.why: Sylas has two dashes; knowing W blanks both changes when you hold it. Abscond is 13/12/11/10/9s, Kingslayer drops to 6s at rank 5, which is why chip trades stop working later.
audit.corrected: Both named with cooldowns, and W stated as stopping either one — slowing and grounding him where he lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal sat in the item list with no timing attached, while the whole lane is decided by whether Kingslayer out-heals your chip.
audit.why: Flagged missing interaction: Kingslayer heals him against champions and reaches a 6s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing written into the mid and late paragraphs and into whys[5] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown had no number.
audit.why: Abscond at 13s rank 1 is the real punish window and Kingslayer's shrinking cooldown is why the lane closes.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, a full-AP Sylas drain-heals through your flat damage. Carry threat 8.5/10 — close it before the map decides.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond is the dash, Abduct the chain recast — 13s at rank 1, and W stops it and Kingslayer both.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — a 13s dash with a chain recast; W stops it and the Kingslayer lunge alike, slowing and grounding him. Bait it, then commit. - Your E: never spend it without a wall. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — E wall-stun + Q burst.
edits.after: Track Abscond / Abduct: a 13s dash plus chain recast, and W stops it and Kingslayer both. Bait it — then E wall-stun + Q burst.

edits.before: Your cheap tank/bruiser spike out-trades his pre-item drain while his W still costs real mana.
edits.after: Your cheap tank spike out-trades Kingslayer's drain — get Grievous Wounds up before any long trade.

edits.before: Through levels 4-6 your point-and-click reliability beats his execution-dependent kit: every E he throws to engage or escape is W-blockable, and you do percent-HP damage regardless of your gold. His R steals your Keeper's Verdict but a charged knock-up is clunky in his hands, so it is a peel tool for him, not a burst — bait it and keep trading. At first item your cheap components let you tank his drain and out-trade, since his mana cost on W is real and your Q chunk is free.
edits.after: Through levels 4-6 your point-and-click reliability beats his execution-dependent kit: every Abscond he throws to engage or escape is W-stoppable, and so is the Kingslayer lunge, while your percent-HP damage ignores your gold. His R steals Keeper's Verdict, but a charged knock-up is clunky in his hands — peel for him, not burst — so bait it and keep trading. Get Grievous Wounds up before the first long trade: Kingslayer falls to a 6s cooldown and heals him out of chip you win.

edits.before: This is where Sylas reclaims it — full AP with Q/W drain heal lets him out-sustain your flat low base damage, and he kites your wall-dependent stun all day. Your win is already banked from early-mid: take the side lane, use W to deny his E roams, and let your CC and percent-HP damage matter in skirmishes rather than chasing a 1v1 you no longer win. Do not greed the late solo kill — peel and disrupt.
edits.after: This is where Sylas reclaims it — full AP, Kingslayer's heal out-sustains your flat base damage and he kites your wall-dependent stun all day, so anti-heal is no longer optional. Your win is already banked from early-mid: take the side lane, use W to deny his Abscond roams, and let your CC and percent-HP damage matter in skirmishes rather than chasing a 1v1 you no longer win. Do not greed the late solo kill — peel and disrupt.

edits.before: Chunk him with max-HP Q while he is forced to drain-trade with W into you
edits.after: Chunk him with max-HP Q, Grievous Wounds up before he drain-trades Kingslayer

edits.before: Level 3 with all basics you punish any misposition against a wall, and W grounds his engage dash.
edits.after: Level 3, all basics up: W grounds Abscond or the Kingslayer lunge and the wall stun punishes either.

notes: Kingslayer (W) is a dash as well as a heal, so Steadfast Presence stops it too — the page only ever credited W against Abscond. Anti-heal timing tied to Kingslayer's 6s late cooldown per the missing-interaction flag. Level chart rows 4 and 6 flipped in pairs; row 6 had been claiming Poppy while its own why said Sylas out-scales. UNVERIFIED: the page describes Abduct (E recast) as a stun in four places. Riot's description in the kit file only says it pulls him to the enemy hit, and the derived flags list projectile and dash but no hardCC. I did not assert either way and left that wording untouched.
